roles.name: dsdm-business-sponsor
roles.description: Own the business case, budget, and ultimate project authorization.
responsibilities: Own continued business justification and authorize governance decisions.
escalationRules: Do not delegate final business authorization to an agent.

roles.name: dsdm-business-visionary
roles.description: Maintain the business vision and own expected benefits.
responsibilities: Set strategic business direction and approve alignment of requirements.
escalationRules: Resolve conflicting business interpretations through the named human visionary.

roles.name: dsdm-technical-coordinator
roles.description: Own technical direction, architecture integrity, and development standards.
responsibilities: Coordinate technical decisions and protect solution integrity.
escalationRules: Escalate unresolved architecture risk to the business visionary and project manager.

roles.name: dsdm-project-manager
roles.description: Coordinate project delivery, governance, risk, and resources.
responsibilities: Maintain project control without directing the solution team task by task.
escalationRules: Escalate threats to time, budget, or governance.

roles.name: dsdm-business-analyst
roles.description: Bridge business and solution concerns through evolving requirements.
responsibilities: Shape, prioritize, and trace requirements to the business need.
escalationRules: Escalate requirements that cannot be tied to the business case.

roles.name: dsdm-team-leader
roles.description: Support the solution development team and coordinate daily delivery.
responsibilities: Keep the team focused on timebox objectives and visible blockers.

roles.name: dsdm-business-ambassador
roles.description: Provide day-to-day empowered business decisions for the solution team.
responsibilities: Clarify requirements and accept fitness for business purpose within delegated authority.
escalationRules: Refer decisions outside delegated authority to the business visionary.

roles.name: dsdm-solution-developer
roles.description: Design and build increments of the evolving solution.
responsibilities: Implement the agreed timebox scope with continuous verification.
escalationRules: Surface technical blockers and scope threats rather than hiding them.

roles.name: dsdm-solution-tester
roles.description: Assure solution quality throughout iterative development.
responsibilities: Define and execute evidence-based testing throughout the timebox.
escalationRules: Block deployment when agreed quality is not demonstrated.

roles.name: dsdm-business-advisor
roles.description: Provide specialist business knowledge when requested.
responsibilities: Advise the empowered team without taking its decisions.
escalationRules: Route decisions to the appropriate empowered business role.

roles.name: dsdm-technical-advisor
roles.description: Provide specialist technical or compliance knowledge when requested.
responsibilities: Advise on specialist technical constraints and risks.
escalationRules: Escalate material unresolved risks to the technical coordinator.

roles.name: dsdm-workshop-facilitator
roles.description: Plan and facilitate outcome-focused collaborative workshops.
responsibilities: Keep workshops neutral, prepared, and directed toward agreed outputs.
escalationRules: Escalate missing authority or participation before the workshop.

roles.name: dsdm-coach
roles.description: Guide appropriate use and tailoring of the DSDM approach.
responsibilities: Coach the team and protect the intent of the framework during tailoring.
escalationRules: Document material tailoring decisions and their risks.
